## Data

```{r}
#| label: data

library(tidyverse)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)

nba_full <- read.csv("full_1_57_dperf.csv")
nba_full <- nba_full %>%
  filter(game_time_min <= 48)


dperf_cols <- names(nba_full)[grepl("^dPerf_", names(nba_full))]


players <- names(nba_full) %>%
  str_subset("^Perf_") %>%
  str_remove("^Perf_")

filter_player_games <- function(data, player, threshold = 10){

  dperf_col <- paste0("dPerf_", player)

  data %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    filter(sum(abs(.data[[dperf_col]]), na.rm = TRUE) > threshold) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```

```{r}
# specific number of sims (1000)
simulate_null_player_binned <- function(data, player, bin_width = 2, game_length = 48, n_sims = 1000) {

  dperf_col <- paste0("dPerf_", player)

  dat <- data %>%
    filter(game_time_min >= 0, game_time_min <= game_length) %>%
    mutate(
      bin = floor(game_time_min / bin_width),
      bin = pmin(bin, floor((game_length - 1e-9) / bin_width))
    )

  dperf_pool <- dat %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[dperf_col]]), .data[[dperf_col]] != 0) %>%
    pull(.data[[dperf_col]])

  games <- sort(unique(dat$game_id))
  bins  <- 0:floor((game_length - 1e-9) / bin_width)

  k_by_bin <- map(bins, function(b) {
    dat %>%
      filter(bin == b, !is.na(.data[[dperf_col]]), .data[[dperf_col]] != 0) %>%
      count(game_id, name = "k") %>%
      right_join(tibble(game_id = games), by = "game_id") %>%
      mutate(k = ifelse(is.na(k), 0L, k)) %>%
      pull(k)
  })
  names(k_by_bin) <- as.character(bins)

  map_dfr(seq_len(n_sims), function(g) {

    map_dfr(bins, function(b) {

      k_vec <- k_by_bin[[as.character(b)]]
      if (length(k_vec) == 0) k_vec <- 0L

      k <- sample(k_vec, 1)

      if (k == 0) {
        return(tibble(
          player = player,
          sim_game = g,
          bin = b,
          event_id = integer(0),
          game_time_min = numeric(0),
          sim_dPerf = numeric(0)
        ))
      }

      bin_start <- b * bin_width
      bin_end   <- min((b + 1) * bin_width, game_length)

      tibble(
        player = player,
        sim_game = g,
        bin = b,
        event_id = seq_len(k),
        game_time_min = sort(runif(k, bin_start, bin_end)),
        sim_dPerf = sample(dperf_pool, k, replace = TRUE)
      )
    })
  })
}
```

```{r}
#| label: get smoothed bounds

library(tidyverse)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1) Build simulation matrix on a common time grid
build_sim_matrix_from_df <- function(
  df,
  sim_col = "sim_game",
  time_col = "game_time_min",
  value_col = "sim_Perf",
  t_grid = NULL,
  T_max = 48,
  grid_by = 1/60
) {
  if (is.null(t_grid)) {
    t_grid <- seq(0, T_max, by = grid_by)
  }
  t_grid <- sort(unique(t_grid))

  sim_ids <- sort(unique(df[[sim_col]]))
  B <- length(sim_ids)
  TT <- length(t_grid)

  sim_mat <- matrix(0, nrow = B, ncol = TT)
  rownames(sim_mat) <- sim_ids
  colnames(sim_mat) <- t_grid

  for (i in seq_along(sim_ids)) {
    sid <- sim_ids[i]

    d <- df %>%
      filter(.data[[sim_col]] == sid) %>%
      arrange(.data[[time_col]]) %>%
      select(all_of(c(time_col, value_col)))

    times <- d[[time_col]]
    vals  <- d[[value_col]]

    if (length(times) == 0) {
      sim_mat[i, ] <- 0
      next
    }

    # if duplicate event times exist, keep the last cumulative value
    if (anyDuplicated(times)) {
      keep <- !duplicated(times, fromLast = TRUE)
      times <- times[keep]
      vals  <- vals[keep]
    }

    sim_mat[i, ] <- approx(
      x = c(0, times),
      y = c(0, vals),
      xout = t_grid,
      method = "constant",
      f = 0,
      rule = 2,
      ties = "ordered"
    )$y
  }

  list(sim = sim_mat, t_grid = t_grid)
}

#--------------------------------------------------
# 2) Build smoothed upper quantile band
#--------------------------------------------------
#no inflation
make_upper_quantile_band <- function(
  sim_mat,
  t_grid,
  q = 0.95,
  spar = 0.6
) {
  raw_upper <- apply(sim_mat, 2, quantile, probs = q, na.rm = TRUE, type = 8)

  ss <- smooth.spline(x = t_grid, y = raw_upper, spar = spar)
  upper <- pmax(predict(ss, x = t_grid)$y, 0)

  tibble(
    game_time_min = t_grid,
    upper_line = upper
  )
}

#no inflation
get_upper_bound <- function(null_perf, q = 0.90) {

  sim_col   <- "sim_game"
  time_col  <- "game_time_min"
  value_col <- "sim_Perf"
  T_max     <- 48
  grid_by   <- 1/60
  spar      <- 0.6

  sim_obj <- build_sim_matrix_from_df(
    df = null_perf,
    sim_col = sim_col,
    time_col = time_col,
    value_col = value_col,
    T_max = T_max,
    grid_by = grid_by
  )

  raw_upper <- apply(
    sim_obj$sim,
    2,
    quantile,
    probs = q,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    type = 8
  )

  ss <- smooth.spline(
    x = sim_obj$t_grid,
    y = raw_upper,
    spar = spar
  )

  upper_line <- pmax(
    predict(ss, x = sim_obj$t_grid)$y,
    0
  )

  tibble(
    game_time_min = sim_obj$t_grid,
    upper_line = upper_line
  )
}
```

```{r}
#build nulls
build_null_perf <- function(null_df){

  null_df %>%
    arrange(player, sim_game, game_time_min) %>%
    group_by(player, sim_game) %>%
    mutate(sim_Perf = cumsum(sim_dPerf)) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```

```{r}
#| label: main function
results <- map(players, function(p) {

  cat("Processing:", p, "\n")

  filtered <- filter_player_games(nba_full, p, threshold = 10)

  null_events <- simulate_null_player_binned(filtered, p, n_sims = 1000) #add this:, n_sims = 1000

  null_perf <- build_null_perf(null_events)

  upper_bound <- get_upper_bound(null_perf, q = 0.95)%>%
  mutate(player = p)

  list(
    player = p,
    null_perf = null_perf,
    upper_bound = upper_bound
  )
})
```

```{r}
#| label: attach nulls and bounds
all_null_perf <- map_dfr(results, "null_perf")
all_upper_bounds <- map_dfr(results, "upper_bound")
```

```{r}
#| label: get real game data
real_long <- map_dfr(players, function(p) {

  perf_col  <- paste0("Perf_", p)
  dperf_col <- paste0("dPerf_", p)

  nba_full %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    filter(sum(abs(.data[[dperf_col]]), na.rm = TRUE) > 10) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(game_id, game_time_min, !!sym(perf_col)) %>%
    rename(obs_perf = !!sym(perf_col)) %>%
    mutate(player = p) %>%
    filter(!is.na(obs_perf))
})
```

```{r}
for (p in players) {

  p_null  <- all_null_perf %>% filter(player == p)
  p_bound <- all_upper_bounds %>% filter(player == p)

  print(
    ggplot() +
      geom_step(
        data = p_null,
        aes(x = game_time_min, y = sim_Perf, group = sim_game),
        alpha = 0.22,
        linewidth = 0.5,
        color = "black"
      ) +
      geom_line(
        data = p_bound,
        aes(x = game_time_min, y = upper_line),
        linewidth = 0.8,
        color = "red"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(
        title = paste("Simulated Null Games with Upper Bound:", p),
        x = "Game Time (Minutes)",
        y = "Performance"
      )
  )
}
```

```{r}

for (p in players) {

  p_null <- null_final_perf %>%
    filter(player == p) %>%
    mutate(type = "Null")

  p_obs <- obs_final_perf %>%
    filter(player == p) %>%
    mutate(type = "Observed")

  plot_df <- bind_rows(p_null, p_obs)

  print(
    ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = final_perf, fill = type)) +

        alpha = 0.5,
        bins = 30,
        position = "identity"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(
        title = paste("End-of-Game Performance Distribution:", p),
        x = "Final Performance",
        y = "Count",
        fill = ""
      )
  )
}

```

```{r}
#| label: Null density with observed histogram

for (p in players) {

  p_null <- null_final_perf %>%
    filter(player == p)

  p_obs <- obs_final_perf %>%
    filter(player == p)

  print(
    ggplot() +
      geom_histogram(
        data = p_obs,
        aes(x = final_perf, y = after_stat(density)),
        bins = 15,
        fill = "deepskyblue",
        alpha = 0.45
      ) +
      geom_density(
        data = p_null,
        aes(x = final_perf),
        color = "black",
        linewidth = .86
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(
        title = paste("End-of-Game Performance:", p),
        subtitle = "Blue histogram = observed games, red curve = simulated null density",
        x = "Final Performance",
        y = "Density"
      )
  )
}
```

## Heat Area

```{r}
#| label: heat area function for real games

detect_heat_intervals_with_area_compact <- function(player_name, real_long, all_upper_bounds,
                                                    digits = 1, area_digits = 2) {

  bound_df <- all_upper_bounds %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    arrange(game_time_min)

  player_games <- real_long %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    distinct(game_id)

  blocks <- real_long %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    arrange(game_id, game_time_min) %>%
    mutate(
      upper_line = approx(
        x = bound_df$game_time_min,
        y = bound_df$upper_line,
        xout = game_time_min,
        rule = 2
      )$y,
      excess = obs_perf - upper_line,
      above = excess > 0
    ) %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    mutate(
      block = cumsum(above != lag(above, default = first(above))),
      dt = game_time_min - lag(game_time_min),
      trap = ifelse(
        above & lag(above, default = FALSE),
        ((excess + lag(excess, default = 0)) / 2) * dt,
        0
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(above) %>%
    group_by(game_id, block) %>%
    summarise(
      t_in = min(game_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
      t_out = max(game_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
      area = sum(trap, na.rm = TRUE),
      duration = t_out - t_in,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      t_in = round(t_in, digits),
      t_out = round(t_out, digits),
      area = round(area, area_digits),
      duration = round(duration, 2),
      interval = paste0(t_in, "–", t_out)
    )

  heat_summary <- blocks %>%
    group_by(game_id) %>%
    summarise(
      n_intervals = n(),
      intervals = paste(interval, collapse = "; "),
      areas = paste(area, collapse = "; "),
      durations = paste(duration, collapse = "; "),
      total_heat_area = round(sum(area), area_digits),
      total_heat_time = round(sum(duration), 2),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  player_games %>%
    left_join(heat_summary, by = "game_id") %>%
    mutate(
      n_intervals = ifelse(is.na(n_intervals), 0L, n_intervals),
      intervals = ifelse(is.na(intervals), "", intervals),
      areas = ifelse(is.na(areas), "", areas),
      durations = ifelse(is.na(durations), "", durations),
      total_heat_area = ifelse(is.na(total_heat_area), 0, total_heat_area),
      total_heat_time = ifelse(is.na(total_heat_time), 0, total_heat_time)
    ) %>%
    arrange(game_id)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: heat area function for simulated games

detect_heat_intervals_with_area_compact_null <- function(player_name, all_null_perf, all_upper_bounds,
                                                         digits = 1, area_digits = 2) {

  bound_df <- all_upper_bounds %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    arrange(game_time_min)

  sim_games <- all_null_perf %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    distinct(sim_game)

  blocks <- all_null_perf %>%
    filter(player == player_name) %>%
    arrange(sim_game, game_time_min) %>%
    mutate(
      upper_line = approx(
        x = bound_df$game_time_min,
        y = bound_df$upper_line,
        xout = game_time_min,
        rule = 2
      )$y,
      excess = sim_Perf - upper_line,
      above = excess > 0
    ) %>%
    group_by(sim_game) %>%
    mutate(
      block = cumsum(above != lag(above, default = first(above))),
      dt = game_time_min - lag(game_time_min),
      trap = ifelse(
        above & lag(above, default = FALSE),
        ((excess + lag(excess, default = 0)) / 2) * dt,
        0
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(above) %>%
    group_by(sim_game, block) %>%
    summarise(
      t_in = min(game_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
      t_out = max(game_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
      area = sum(trap, na.rm = TRUE),
      duration = t_out - t_in,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      t_in = round(t_in, digits),
      t_out = round(t_out, digits),
      area = round(area, area_digits),
      duration = round(duration, 2),
      interval = paste0(t_in, "–", t_out)
    )

  heat_summary <- blocks %>%
    group_by(sim_game) %>%
    summarise(
      n_intervals = n(),
      intervals = paste(interval, collapse = "; "),
      areas = paste(area, collapse = "; "),
      durations = paste(duration, collapse = "; "),
      total_heat_area = round(sum(area), area_digits),
      total_heat_time = round(sum(duration), 2),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  sim_games %>%
    left_join(heat_summary, by = "sim_game") %>%
    mutate(
      n_intervals = ifelse(is.na(n_intervals), 0L, n_intervals),
      intervals = ifelse(is.na(intervals), "", intervals),
      areas = ifelse(is.na(areas), "", areas),
      durations = ifelse(is.na(durations), "", durations),
      total_heat_area = ifelse(is.na(total_heat_area), 0, total_heat_area),
      total_heat_time = ifelse(is.na(total_heat_time), 0, total_heat_time)
    ) %>%
    arrange(sim_game)
}
```

```{r}
    player_name = p,
    real_long = real_long,
    all_upper_bounds = all_upper_bounds
  ) %>%
    mutate(player = p) %>%
    select(player, everything())

})
```

## More Summary Stats + visuals

```{r}
#| label: top40 games

top40_games_obs <- heat_tables_obs %>%
  arrange(desc(total_heat_area)) %>%
  slice(1:40)

top40_games_obs
```

```{r}
#| label: plot top 40 games
for(i in 1:nrow(top40_games_obs)){

  p  <- top40_games_obs$player[i]
  g  <- top40_games_obs$game_id[i]
  area_val <- round(top40_games_obs$total_heat_area[i], 2)
  time_val <- round(top40_games_obs$total_heat_time[i], 2)

  bound_df <- all_upper_bounds %>%
    filter(player == p) %>%
    arrange(game_time_min)

  # real game
  game_data <- real_long %>%
    filter(player == p, game_id == g) %>%
    arrange(game_time_min)

  if(nrow(game_data) > 0){

    game_data <- game_data %>%
      mutate(
        upper_line = approx(
          x = bound_df$game_time_min,
          y = bound_df$upper_line,
          xout = game_time_min,
          rule = 2
        )$y,
        above = obs_perf > upper_line,
        shade_ymin = upper_line,
        shade_ymax = ifelse(above, obs_perf, upper_line)
      )

    print(
      ggplot(game_data, aes(game_time_min, obs_perf)) +

        # shaded region above upper bound
        geom_ribbon(
          aes(ymin = shade_ymin, ymax = shade_ymax),
          alpha = 0.25
        ) +

        # observed line
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +

        # upper bound
        geom_line(
          aes(y = upper_line),
          color = "red",
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = 0.7
        ) +

        theme_minimal() +
        labs(
          title = paste("Player:", p),
          subtitle = paste(
            "Game ID:", g,
            "| Total Heat Area:", area_val,
            "| Total Heat Minutes:", time_val
          ),
          x = "Game Time (minutes)",
          y = "Cumulative Performance"
        )
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
  print(
    ggplot(df, aes(x = type, y = prop, fill = type)) +
      geom_col(width = .6) +

        obs_prop_hot = "Observed",

      )) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkgreen", "gray70")) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(

      ) +

  )
```
